name: Afro House DJ
style: Afro house, deep house, amapiano, techno and electronic
spec: One DJ, plus live tabla hand drums on request
alt: A DJ holding headphones to one ear under purple and pink stage light.
blurb: A great house track gets people out onto the dance floor, and live drums over the top of it can keep them there. This Denver DJ plays Afro house, deep house, amapiano (a style of house music built around piano), techno and electronic music, and can play the tabla over the set, so you get a DJ and a live drummer in one person. It's a great booking for after-parties, holiday parties, weddings and birthdays across Colorado.
identity: The DJ trained in Indian classical music on the tabla, a pair of hand drums. The set works just as well without the drums, so just let us know what you'd like.

The DJ has played Denver's house clubs and club nights in Chicago, San Francisco, San Diego and Hong Kong. They can play a relaxed warm-up set, a high-energy set, or one long set that builds from one to the other.
